authority: Stable engineering identity is the part/assembly/drawing number. Lifecycle state belongs in metadata and the Engineering Build Graph, never in the canonical identity.

rules.revision_rule: Revision is metadata/property/thread state and must not be encoded into the canonical CAD filename.
rules.migration_rule: Existing stateful native CAD filenames are audited first. Renaming is a controlled one-time migration using SOLIDWORKS reference-safe rename/replace workflow; this overlay never bulk-renames live CAD files.

release_gate: No new stateful CAD filenames may be introduced after identity migration is approved. Existing stateful filenames remain migration debt until reference-safe migration is executed.
